name: Meituan (Class B)
blurb: Meituan is a Chinese technology-driven retail and local-services platform operating across mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan, and select international markets. Its Core Local Commerce segment encompasses food delivery, in-store dining, hotel and travel booking, while its New Initiatives segment spans bike and e-moped sharing, power-bank rental, micro-credit, and the Kuailv and Xiaoxiang Supermarket formats. The company also operates a B2B food distribution business and sells online marketing services to merchants on its platform. With roughly 111,000 employees and trailing twelve-month revenue of approximately CNY 406 billion (+8.1% YoY), Meituan is one of China's largest consumer-internet platforms by both scale and transaction volume.
recent: Meituan shares trade around HK$85.70 as of May 14, 2026, down roughly 38% from their 52-week high of HK$149.80, with analysts at Morningstar flagging intensifying competitive pressure that is expected to slow customer-acquisition growth (note published March 27, 2026). The company is scheduled to report earnings on May 26, 2026, which is acting as the near-term catalyst focus; the stock remains net-loss territory (trailing net income approximately −CNY 26 billion) and carries no dividend. Volume has been running well above the 35-million-share daily average, signaling heightened trader interest ahead of the print.
